notes: NEX Security Engineer Evidence Specialist · founder-authorised 2026-09-12. Constitutional purpose: 'Produce security evidence · never declare a system secure.' Advisory. Deterministic. Findings are observations, not verdicts.
constitutional_purpose_locked: Finding a potential vulnerability is not the same as declaring the system insecure. The specialist reports observations. NEX3 adjudicates. NEX3 gate 3 (security) currently HOLDs on missing security evidence — this specialist fills that gap without ever claiming safety.

outcomes_permitted.NO_FINDING_IN_SCOPE: in-scope rulesets found no matching pattern · NOT 'secure' · scope-limited absence-of-witnessed-finding
outcomes_permitted.FINDINGS_PRESENT: one or more findings emitted with location + rule_id + severity + tool + version
outcomes_permitted.SCOPE_INCOMPLETE: one or more rulesets could not be executed · partial coverage · results are advisory
outcomes_permitted.NOT_MEASURED: no tool bindings available · no scope defined · specialist did not proceed

invariants: MUST NOT emit 'secure' / 'safe' / 'no vulnerabilities' · only NO_FINDING_IN_SCOPE or FINDINGS_PRESENT with explicit ruleset + scope
MUST NOT interpret exploitability · reports raw + CWE/CVE only
